messages:
Jules: Reminder - freeze window starts in 15m (21:00 PT). Posting the final rollout checklist and rollback lanes. Call out blockers now.

Meera: Running a focused smoke on staging (auth, inference, embed paths). ETA 6m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pinned: canary-2976543210 (service: inference, version: v3.16.0). Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to v3.15.8 --reason "emergency"`.

Anoop: Canary metrics look stable: 1m error 0.08% (baseline 0.10%), P95 +7ms. Small cache warmup at t+1m resolved.

Kara: Confirmed no DB migrations. Only a config toggle (routing.weight) in config-service. I'll be ready to flip back and will log timestamps.

oncall: I'm primary for the next 60m. Temp alert set: error_rate > 2x baseline OR P95 > baseline +100ms. Runbook bookmarked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/launch-freeze

Sam: Release notes pushed to Console; included rollback steps and rollback owner. Docs PR on hold until freeze lifts.

Jules: Rollback decision criteria: sustained error rate >= 3x baseline for 5m, P95 > baseline +100ms over 3 1-min windows, or any customer-facing regression. If you see this, post `rollback` and tag @oncall.

Meera: Smoke green. Auth flows and embeddings OK. Small transient 0.2% error blip at t+2m looks like client retries.

Anoop: Emergency unpin (if CLI unreachable): `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/unpin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS' -d '{"service":"inference","version":"v3.15.8"}'` (ops token required) - coordinate with oncall.

Jules: Please ack with one-word so we have an audit trail.

Meera: ack
Anoop: ack
Kara: ack
oncall: ack
Sam: ack

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Status: canary-2976543210 healthy at 5% traffic after 7m. Will post next update in 5m. Automated rollback available via `/deploy rollback --auto`.
